mapper.sql: id, login_name, ip_address, login_location, browser_type, os, status, msg, is_deleted, create_time, update_time
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys_login_log (login_name, ip_address, login_location, browser_type, os, status, msg) VALUES (#{loginName}, #{ipAddress}, #{loginLocation}, #{browserType}, #{os}, #{status}, #{msg})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM sys_login_log WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_login_log SET is_deleted = 1 WHERE id = #{id}
